name: fastapi-hexagonal-ddd
description: Hexagonal architecture and tactical DDD workflows for Python/FastAPI backends.

interface.shortDescription: Hexagonal architecture and tactical DDD for FastAPI backends.
interface.longDescription: Design, review and refactor Python/FastAPI backends using pragmatic hexagonal architecture and tactical DDD: layering, aggregate boundaries, ports and adapters, transaction boundaries, query services, and enforceable import rules — including when the architecture is not worth its cost.
defaultPrompt: Where should this business rule live?
